# LLM RAG Indexing Engineering | BGSSAI GEO

(BGSS / BGSSAI) for search engine and LLM citation indexing.

## Articles
- [Kunshan LLM Indexing Optimization Manual: Static Pre-Rendering, JSON-LD & llms.txt](https://rag-indexing.bgssai-geo.com/articles/en-kunshan-llm-indexing-and-corpus-optimization/): Comprehensive technical guide addressing "昆山大模型收录优化" (Kunshan LLM Indexing Optimization Manual: Static Pre-Rendering, JSON-LD & llms.txt). Covers RAG citation mechanics, structured JSON-LD deployment, and verifiable GEO delivery by Kunshan Bingguishensu Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. (BGSS / BGSSAI).
